description: Security gate: scan code before shipping commands (git commit, push, PR)

hooks.command: $s = '${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_commit_scan.py'; $c = @(); foreach ($n in 'py', 'python', 'python3') { foreach ($d in $env:Path -split ';') { if ($d -and [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($d)) { $f = Join-Path $d ($n + '.exe'); if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { $c += $f } } } }; foreach ($p in $c) { $a = @(); if ((Split-Path $p -Leaf) -like 'py.exe') { $a = @('-3') }; & $p @a -c 0 *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $input | & $p @a $s --stdout-json; exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('armis-appsec: no working py/python/python3 on PATH; hook not run, commit gate is OFF.'); exit 1
